newsitem.title: USA: CSCE March world sugar falls 0.34 to 10.32.
newsitem.headline: CSCE March world sugar falls 0.34 to 10.32.

text.p: CSCE March world sugar futures fell below support to 10.32, down 0.34 cent a lb, on technically-driven fund selling, floor sources said.
Support was pegged at 10.34, the recent low made Nov 18.
Early, March filled a gap on the charts between 10.50 and 10.48 and then continued to rack up losses.
Several market sources had expected prices to reverse course based on a technically oversold condition. But light short-covering was not enough to support the market and fuel prices higher.
A lack of physical offtake continues to weigh on the market, dealers said.
At 1227 EST, the most-active month was down 0.33 to 10.33, traded 10.65 to 10.32. The back months were 0.20 to 0.28 weaker.
